subject: Clarify: no-train commitment, prompt/response ownership & evidence delivery
messages:
From: Bethany Smythe <bethany.smythe@scalehealth.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@scalehealth.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify: no-train commitment, prompt/response ownership & evidence delivery

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the call yesterday. Procurement and InfoSec asked me to get everything in writing so we can move to PO and signature. Two quick asks that we need clarified in the DPA/addendum before we can sign:

1) No-training/no-derive commitment: We need an explicit commitment that ScaleHealth data (prompts, attachments, and generated responses) will not be used to train, fine-tune, or improve any Redwood-hosted models, including internal research pipelines, and a short description of the technical controls that enforce that.

2) Ownership & derivatives: Confirm that prompt text and generated responses for our tenant are considered customer data and that ScaleHealth retains ownership of the outputs; we need wording suitable for our legal team (they'll paste into their standard language).

3) Evidence & export: InfoSec wants a reproducible evidence package proving the above for an initial onboarding audit. Prefer SFTP delivery of the evidence package (we have an SFTP endpoint), and we need the format defined (audit CSV + hashes).

Could you attach the proposed redlines and an example of the evidence package (just a stub is fine)? Procurement also needs an estimated time-to-deliver for the evidence after signing.

Appreciate it — Bethany
Bethany Smythe

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Clarify: no-train commitment, prompt/response ownership & evidence delivery

Hi Bethany — thanks for the clear list. Attaching a single-file redline for the DPA with the no-train/addendum language we've provisionally proposed (ScaleHealth_DPA_proposed_redlines.docx). High-level answers below, and I've looped in Dev and Marcus for the evidence/export feasibility and timeline.

1) No-train commitment: Proposed clause (excerpt in redline): Redwood agrees not to use ScaleHealth customer data to train, fine-tune, or otherwise improve production or research machine learning models without explicit written consent. We propose a definition section that enumerates "Customer Data" (prompts, attachments, generated responses, metadata). Enforcement: we will route ScaleHealth traffic to a flagged tenant bucket with no downstream replication to research clusters and with isolation of model-optimization pipelines.

2) Ownership & derivatives: Proposed language gives ScaleHealth ownership of customer inputs and generated outputs; Redwood takes a limited license to process and store outputs for operational purposes only (retention scoped in the DPA). We included a short warranty paragraph suitable for your legal team.

3) Evidence & export: We can produce an evidence package containing: (a) a CSV audit log of ingest events with timestamps and checksums; (b) an access-control snapshot showing no cross-tenant export rules; (c) a signed statement from our Ops lead certifying the no-training routing configuration (PDF). For format: we suggest a single ZIP delivered to your SFTP endpoint with file manifest and SHA256 hashes. Example stub attached: proof_of_non_training.csv (contains sample headers and fake rows for structure).

Timeline: After signature, initial evidence delivery within 7 business days for the onboarding audit. For SOC-level attestations (if you require periodic attestations) we can discuss quarterly cadence in the contract.

Next step: Tell us the SFTP host/credentials (or a short-lived presigned PUT URL) and whether procurement wants DocuSign or another execution flow.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Clarify: no-train commitment, prompt/response ownership & evidence delivery

Kimberly / Bethany — quick technical note on the evidence package and controls so expectations are aligned.

- Isolation: For customers who opt into a no-train addendum we already support tenant routing to an isolated serving pool. That pool does not feed into our model training pipelines; we also disable any telemetry exports from that pool to internal research stores.

- Evidence contents: The proof_of_non_training.csv stub included by Kimberly shows the essential fields we can produce: event_id, tenant_id, timestamp_utc, request_hash (SHA256 of prompt + attachments metadata), model_variant, serving_pool_id, op_id. We can also include a per-file manifest with SHA256 for each exported artifact.

- Retention: We will produce the initial evidence snapshot (7 business days post-signature). If ScaleHealth requires an ongoing retention/export schedule (e.g., monthly attestations), we can automate that but it will need to be scoped in the SOW (additional fee possible depending on frequency/retention window).

- Subprocessor notes: If you require subprocessor names or a flow for subprocessor access requests we can include a subprocessor inventory CSV and a timeline for approvals. Marcus — can you confirm SFTP packaging endpoint size limits (we typically handle <100MB for these packages)?

Thanks,
Dev
Senior Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai
